svg.text: Why the cell kept running in the video

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: writeStream.start() returns immediately — it hands back a handle and lets the notebook carry on while the stream runs behind it.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Assigning it to a variable and calling query.awaitTermination() makes the cell block until the stream finishes and then exit cleanly.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Without that, a notebook cell driving a stream looks like it has hung, whichever trigger you chose.
